title: Forms, lists and guides
description: Everything a parent typically needs on paper, in one place. All files are PDFs and open in a new tab.

items.title: Admission Enquiry Form 2026–27
items.description: The printable enquiry form for families who prefer to submit at the school office rather than online.

items.title: Admission Document Checklist
items.description: Every document required at admission, listed by grade, with notes on what a transfer certificate must show.

items.title: Book Set Details & Approximate Cost
items.description: Grade-wise book sets with the approximate cost of each, as published by the school office.

items.title: School Uniform Guide
items.description: The complete formal and sports uniform requirement for every section, including footwear and hair rules.

items.title: Academic Calendar 2026–27
items.description: Term dates, examination periods, celebrations and holidays for the session. Dates are provisional and confirmed by circular.

items.title: School Timings & Contact Sheet
items.description: Section timings, office hours, and the numbers to call for admissions, accounts and general enquiries.

items.title: Campus Safety & Child Protection Summary
items.description: CCTV coverage, gate protocol, identity cards, the authorised-person rule and the section attendant arrangement.

items.title: Teaching Post Application Form
items.description: The printable application form for teaching and non-teaching positions at the school and junior college.
